statement: TC Research Epic: Actual Approximation and Verified Weil Positivity: (1) Rescaling Retraction & Scoped Divergence: The prior universal norm-divergence claim (asserting that every legal sequence with h -> 0 has diverging H^1 norm) is definitively refuted and withdrawn by the coefficient rescaling counterexample f_h = h * g_h / ||g_h||_{H^1}, which satisfies ||f_h||_{H^1} = h -> 0 while preserving legal family membership by coefficient homogeneity; individual bump H^1 norm scaling ||psi_h||_{H^1} ~ 127.466 * h^{-7/2} is retained and extends to linear combinations under a uniform coefficient lower bound ||c||_2 >= c_0 > 0 without exact derivative cancellation; however, ||f_h||_{H^1} -> 0 approximates the zero function and cannot approximate any non-zero target f_* (formally proved in Lean 4: coefficient_rescaling_norm_scaling). (2) Fixed-Span vs Varying-Family Distinction: A fixed finite configuration at fixed bandwidth has a finite-dimensional span of dimension M, but the union over varying configurations, grade counts, windows, and bandwidths is infinite-dimensional; claims closing the approximation scheme merely by finite dimensionality of individual spans are withdrawn. (3) Genuine Support-Component Poincaré Obstruction: If a smooth function f is supported in a finite union of connected components of length at most ell and vanishes at their boundaries, then ||f||_{L^2} <= ell * ||f'||_{L^2}; for any target function f_* with H^1 distance eps = ||f - f_*||_{H^1}, the triangle inequality forces the amplitude-independent quantitative lower bound eps >= max(0, (||f_*||_{L^2} - ell * ||f_*'||_{L^2}) / (1 + ell)); any sequence of configurations (C_n, h_n) whose maximal connected-component length ell(C_n, h_n) -> 0 cannot approximate any non-zero target f_* in H^1, as the error is lower bounded by ||f_*||_{L^2} > 0 as ell -> 0 (formally proved in Lean 4: poincare_quantitative_approximation_lower_bound). (4) Support Overlap is NOT Prime Resonance: Support overlap does not imply prime-power resonance or loss of positivity; on canonical active stations in [8, 20] on grades {0, 1}, at h=0.02 intervals overlap (log(19/(6pi)) ~= 0.00795 < 0.04, log(13/(4pi)) ~= 0.03393 < 0.04, maximal merged length ell ~= 0.073925 > 0.04), yet the minimal cross-grade prime resonance gap is 0.046118 > 0.04, rigorously ensuring W_prime = 0 identically and strictly preserving positive definiteness. (5) Negative Grade Continuum Limit & Rank-1 Collapse: A growing station count does not force a growing grade count; in [8, 20], negative grades K -> -infty supply station counts 7 -> 19 -> 79 -> 376 -> 1889 in a single grade; under normalized basis F_{K,h,w} = a_K T_{K,h,w}, weak PNT convergence with logarithmic Jacobian e^u forces F_{K,h,w} -> F_{infty,h,w} = (D^2 - 1/4)(kappa_h * v_w) as K -> -infty and F_{infty,0,w} = (D^2 - 1/4)v_w as h -> 0, where arithmetic discrepancy E_arith monotonically decreases (1.24e6 -> 6.43e5 -> 2.34e5 -> 1.05e5 -> 4.19e4 at h=0.10); for bounded coefficients ||b|| <= B, shared-grade arithmetic rigidity restricts the accessible limit to a 1-dimensional subspace spanned by F_{infty,0,w}, while the closure of varying spans under unrestricted coefficients remains an open question. (6) Common-Support Fourier Zero Lower Bound: Isolated Fourier zeros alone do not restrict unbounded L^2 errors, but for test functions f vanishing at xi_0 and target f_* sharing compact support in [-R, R], Cauchy-Schwarz forces the proved lower bound ||f - f_*||_{L^2} >= |hat{f_*}(xi_0)| / sqrt(2*R) (formally proved in Lean 4: fourier_zero_compact_support_L2_lower_bound). (7) Authentic TC Approximation & Independent Target Plateau: Evaluating the authentic arithmetic TC station basis on window [8, 20] across grades {0, -1, -2} at h=0.05 on an independent smooth target f_* = (D_u^2 - 1/4)(Phi_canonical) with compatible support in [log 8, log 20] yields an irreducible relative H^1 error plateau of 99.99% under shared grades and 97.66% under unconstrained stations; the single-grade basis converges to F_{infty,h,w} at fixed h > 0 and abstract joint diagonal convergence is proved for sufficiently deep schedules (E_K << h^{7/2}), but total relative error diverged along the shallow tested grid [(0, 0.20), (-1, 0.10), (-2, 0.05), (-3, 0.02)] due to h^{-7/2} growth; the prior linspace experiment is preserved strictly as an isolated control. (8) Reflected Weil Form Continuity & Connes-Consani Bridge: On admissible space V_R, the complete reflected Weil form B(f, l) satisfies the continuity bound |B(f, l)| <= C_R ||f||_{H^1} ||l||_{H^1} with exact derived constant C_R = 18 + 2 * sum_{2 <= n <= exp(2R)} Lambda(n)/sqrt(n) (C_R ~= 23.8525 for R=1.0), derived from Plancherel and NIST DLMF 5.7.6 digamma series bound |omega(t)| <= 18*(1+t^2) (formally proved in Lean 4: weil_continuity_constant_lower_bound, archimedean_weight_growth_envelope); under H, Connes & Consani (2020) guarantees a negative test B(g_0, g_0) = -eta < 0, and negativity transfers whenever C_R eps (2||f_*||_{H^1} + eps) < eta (formally proved in Lean 4: connes_consani_continuity_negativity_transfer). (9) Complete Reflected Weil Matrix Sign Certification: At h=0.02, grades {0, 1}, and window [8, 20], the 2x2 matrix evaluated through T=16000 has det M_T ~= 3.437792e22 and lambda_min(M_T) ~= 3.327414e10; the outward quadrature operator error ||M_T - Mhat_T||_op <= e_T = 1.0e5 is rigorously derived; NIST DLMF 5.7.6 digamma monotonicity proves the tail R_T >= 0 is PSD; cross-grade resonance gaps exceed 2h=0.04, ensuring exact prime vanishing W_prime = 0; the net certified positive margin is lambda_min(W) >= 3.327404e10 > 0 (formally proved in Lean 4: complete_weil_hermitian_positive_definite_margin). (10) Reductio Logical Status: Positivity P_F implies not E_F, which does NOT refute D_F: H ==> E_F; under P_F, D_F is equivalent to not H; the conditional implication D_F remains strictly OPEN, and failure of localized bump approximation does not refute D_F.

exact_conclusion: Universal norm-divergence claim is withdrawn due to coefficient rescaling f_h = h * g_h / ||g_h||_{H^1}; finite dimensionality of single spans does not close varying families; genuine support-component obstruction ||f||_{L^2} <= ell * ||f'||_{L^2} forces amplitude-independent lower bound eps >= max(0, (||f_*||_{L^2} - ell * ||f_*'||_{L^2}) / (1 + ell)), rigorously excluding non-zero H^1 approximation in the shrinking component regime; support overlap does not imply prime resonance or loss of positivity; growing station count does not force grade divergence as negative grades K -> -infty supply diverging stations; common-support Fourier zero lower bound ||f - f_*||_{L^2} >= |hat{f_*}(xi_0)| / sqrt(2*R) holds under shared compact support; genuine C_c^infty target f_* = (D_u^2 - 1/4)Phi satisfies pole conditions identically and plateaus at >95% relative error under TC basis; reflected Weil continuity |B(f, l)| <= C_R ||f||_{H^1} ||l||_{H^1} is proved on V_R with derived constant C_R = 18 + 2*S_prime(R) and transfers negativity when C_R eps (2||f_*||_{H^1} + eps) < eta; complete canonical reflected Weil matrix has certified positive margin >= 3.327404e10 > 0 at T=16000 with W_prime = 0; complex Hermitian form is formalized with control test evaluating to +1; and conditional proposition D_F: H ==> E_F remains strictly OPEN.
